scope: Exploratory conversion-shape diagnostic; weather already examined, curve outputs not yet computed; not preregistered or generation calibration
selection_reason: These are both named reference models in the preexisting PyPSA-China default configuration; neither selected by pilot output fit. All four pilot sites receive both reference curves.
wind_input: Each of the four frozen nearest responses, 100 m instantaneous speed unchanged, first 8785 endpoints for 8784 intervals
height_scope: 100 m held fixed across all curves to isolate shape; library hub heights 80/90 m are metadata only and not applied; no claim of actual site turbines
multiplier_scope: Retains legacy assumption equally in all curves; not measured availability, wake or electrical losses
reference_normalization: Divide each published power vector by its own maximum; V112 denominator 3.060 MW, not label 3 MW; matches atlite conversion convention
interpolation: Piecewise linear; repeated speed knots encode jumps, exact knot chooses last entry; below first/at or beyond cutout output zero
generic_curve: zero below 3 or at/above25; ((v-3)/9)^3 between3 and12; one between12 and25, times common0.85
interval_rule: Arithmetic mean of endpoint power; assumed linear power between hourly samples, not measured hourly energy
metrics: all 12 uncalibrated means and equivalent hours
pairwise annual differences on same weather and multiplier
tuning: No observed-generation scaling, no adjustment to desired utilization hours, no optimal curve selection
admission: Not admitted as provincial generation input; manufacturer curves, actual hub height, air density, losses and same-scope observations still required
